annotations.title: What a term means in North Carolina (NC) statutes, where it applies

description:
What a term means in the North Carolina (NC) General Statutes — the statutory
definition, and where it applies.

Use whenever a statute's outcome turns on a word that may be DEFINED rather than plain
English ("motor vehicle", "impairing substance", "person", "dwelling"). With `section`,
returns only the definitions whose scope covers that section, most specific first
(section > listed sections > Subpart > Part > Subchapter > Article > Chapter > statewide
rules of construction in G.S. 12-3), each with `why` it applies. Without `section`,
returns every definition of the term grouped by scope — which differ: "board" means a
different body in each chapter that defines it.

Matching: the exact term first, then case and plural folded, then the term inside a
longer defined phrase (flagged `fuzzy`). A definition that only says "has the meaning in
G.S. X" is resolved one step to that section's definition.

Definitions are extracted automatically from the statute text; some lead-ins ("As used
in this act") cannot be tied to a scope and are reported as such, never guessed. Read
the defining section before relying on a definition. get_statute(include_definitions=
True) lists every defined term a section uses.

chapter.description: Limit to definitions made in or scoped to one chapter.

section.description: The section whose text uses the term. Returns ONLY the definitions that legally apply there, most specific first. Strongly recommended.

term.description: The defined word or phrase, as it reads in the statute. Case and plural do not matter.
